description: Before a Datashard save or flag, checks the project's DATASHARD.md names the same install

hooks.command: sh -c 'f=$1; m="The Datashard save check was blocked:"; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { cat >/dev/null; echo "$m node is not on PATH. Install Node.js, then try again." >&2; exit 2; }; [ -f "$f" ] || { cat >/dev/null; echo "$m the plugin file scripts/codex-check-install.mjs is missing. Reinstall the Datashard plugin." >&2; exit 2; }; node "$f" || { echo "$m the check itself failed to run." >&2; exit 2; }' sh "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/codex-check-install.mjs"
hooks.statusMessage: Checking this save belongs to the project's Datashard
